title: Cloud security review
prompt:
Review a reference architecture across identity, data protection, network exposure, audit/threat detection, vulnerability response and incident handling. Record risk, evidence, owner and remediation priority.

Submission: Markdown decision record, diagram (SVG/PNG or Mermaid source if accepted by your reviewer), test/verification plan, risks and teardown confirmation. Use synthetic data. Any hands-on deployment requires an account-owner-approved sandbox; estimate costs first and do not use production credentials.
target_skills: least privilege, safe verification and failure handling

starter.content:
# Cloud security review

## Goal

## Assumptions / prerequisites

## Design or steps

## Verification and failure cases

## Security / privacy / cost

## Cleanup evidence

expected_output: A reviewable design or lab report containing the required concepts, assumptions, verification steps, security controls, failure handling and cost/cleanup notes. No actual cloud deployment is assumed.
acceptance_criteria: Include a section that addresses IAM.
Include a section that addresses encryption.
Include a section that addresses network.
Include a section that addresses monitoring.
Include a section that addresses incident response.
State assumptions and boundaries; do not invent deployed resources or test results.
Include verification evidence, security implications, failure handling and cost/cleanup considerations.
hints: Start with the PDF lesson range and the official references in references/reference-index.json.
State every unknown as unknown; do not fabricate metrics, costs, deployments or screenshots.
Ask a reviewer to verify the design and all cloud mutating steps before an approved lab.
grading_method: Static keyword smoke-check plus human review of the submitted design, security model, correctness, evidence and cost/cleanup. This does not validate a real AWS deployment.
retry_policy: Retries permitted after feedback; the platform controls exercise completion and base XP. No exercise overrides XP.
status_note: Exercise derived from Section C of AWS.pdf. Human review is required; no cloud runner or deployed account is assumed.
